notes: The in-progress marker: one card wears a gold ring showing what is being worked on right now - on the backlog, the thread map and the lineage timeline - plus a tag, a header chip and a Mark as working on this button. It never times out, so it is still there in the morning; a slow pulse on the ring means a Claude session is running this second. It clears itself when the card is finished, parked or deleted.
